items.title: Glover Compton Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: Jelly and I were pretty close. We did a lot of running around together.

ctx.x: Did you ever work at the Deluxe or Deluxe? Where was that? That's Jelly's play spot.

Oh, yeah. Jelly's play spot. See, we all had a spot. Yeah. He liked number two was Tony's spot. He liked number one was my spot. And Deluxe, Frank Pria and Bill Bottoms was there. Jelly Rolls Montage.
